The management endpoint at /mcp has 4 management tools (listWikis, createWiki, archiveWiki, unarchiveWiki) and 4 wiki tools, each wiki tool taking a required wiki name argument.
Every rejection of a WikiFact MCP tool call is returned as a tool error.

onlyBatch.content: The operator console flags a read when the share of searches with 0 reads is over 0.5 (NO_READ_SHARE), the share with 3 or more reads is over 0.3 (MANY_READS_SHARE), or the share of sessions with no search is over 0.3 (NO_SEARCH_SHARE).
WikiFact is written in TypeScript on Node.js 22 with better-sqlite3.
The "replaced by" link served only a consumer that keeps a fact id and reads it later, a use case out of scope (decided October 14, 2026).
A draft that fails the lint twice is a failed attempt because the next attempt can pass.
The console shows a number as data with its definition 1 click or hover away (decided October 16, 2026).
The console's interpretations are 1 list in the code with their status and test (decided October 16, 2026).
In the console, an interpretation that fails its test goes while its data stays (decided October 16, 2026).
Every chart names its axes (decided by the owner on October 16, 2026, third review of the live console).
The tags.name column is COLLATE NOCASE (schema 3).
The fact_version_tags table holds the tags of one fact version (primary key fact_version_id, tag_id).
The fact_version_refs table holds the facts a fact version depends on (primary key fact_version_id, ref_fact_id).
The reject reason `contradicted` versus `unsupported` feeds the repeat detection of docs/future.md.
The only case where a deleted fact is a duplicate is a claim that says the deleted fact is no longer true.
A deleted tag keeps its fact_version_tags rows.
A prompt change runs the question test again on each model because the pool of results starts again for a changed prompt.
In the pipeline, the merge repairs a missed duplicate on the next request in that scope.
The change_requests.status column allows queued, running, done and failed.
In the update worker, the model writes nothing by itself.
In the update worker, code checks each answer by schema checks and timers.

onlyBatch.header: Wrong answer handling in update worker
onlyBatch.content: In the update worker, a wrong answer shows up as a known kind of failure with a known repair.
A schema migration adds columns or tables, or rebuilds a table with every row copied when SQLite cannot alter a constraint in place.
A schema migration never loses a row.
Schema 4 adds the tag_versions table.
Schema 6 adds change_requests.parent_id and the change outcome split.
The Schema 6 migration rebuilds changes for the new CHECK and change_requests for the new column, copying every row with parent_id NULL.
Schema 7 adds the tables sessions, searches, search_results and model_calls and the nullable session_id column on retrievals and tag_retrievals, without rebuilding a table.
SCHEMA_VERSION in src/store/schema.ts became 7.
search_results.target_id has no foreign key, because kind says whether it names a fact or a tag.
The link of a read to its search is computed from search_results, with no column storing it.
SCHEMA_VERSION in src/store/schema.ts is 9.
fact_versions_vec embeddings stay float.
tags_vec embeddings stay float.
The embedding column of current_vec is vec_quantize_binary of the float vector, so the dimension must be a multiple of 8.

onlyBatch.header: Embedded text of a fact version
onlyBatch.content: The embedded text of a fact version is header + ". " + content.
The embedded text of a tag is name + ". " + description.
archiveWiki stops the worker of the wiki and unmounts it before it removes or archives the wiki.
createWiki with the same name and the same subject as an existing wiki returns the existing wiki and creates nothing.

onlyBatch.header: Observed status of later fact versions
onlyBatch.content: A non-first fact version is observed when its justification is not blank and its content or is_deleted differs from the version before it.
